title: Great set of cookware - makes a great gift. Pratical and useful for most kitchens.
text: Great set of cookware - makes a great gift. Pratical and useful for most kitchens.. Great set of pots for the novice cook. These would be great as a shower gift for the bride to be or even just a house warming gift for the first time homeowner/apartment dweller or kid going off to college. Practical, attractive (I absolutely adore this red color) and has pot and pan sizes to meet most daily cooking needs. Adding in the two spatulars is just icing on the cake (work perfectly with the non-stick surface). As others have mentioned, for about $50 more you could buy a more advanced set. However, this set makes a great presentation and has the impressive Paul Deen name on it. I have several of her products in my own kitchen and I know that she does deliver quality products.

description: Give easy-going, delicious home cooking a fresh turn with the convenience of the charming, colorful Paula Deen Riverbend aluminum one-piece nonstick cookware set. Featuring a 1. 5-Quart saucepan with lid, a 2-Quart saucepan with lid, a 3-quart sauté pan with lid, a 6-quart stockpot with lid, 8-inch and 10-inch frying pans, and a slotted turner and spoon, This versatile nonstick aluminum cookware set heats quickly and evenly. Pots and pans feature long-lasting, top-quality nonstick, so foods release in a jiffy and cleanup is a cinch, and the stain-resistant speckled porcelain exterior color Inspired by classic enamelware adds a warm, cozy touch to the kitchen. Suitable for all stovetops, except induction, The nonstick cookware set is conveniently oven safe to 350°f. The pots and pans feature glass lids to seal in heat and flavor while making Paula's delicious cooktop-to-oven recipes. The set includes Paula Deen nylon slotted turner and slotted Spoon, perfect for use with the nonstick interiors. Equip the kitchen For a lifetime of cooking joy and eating enjoyment, With the beautiful Paula Deen Riverbend aluminum one-piece nonstick cookware set.
